_comment: Contract templates. employer: any office from data/politics.json (governor, harbour_master, commander, merchant, planter, priest, broker). needs: marque (a letter of marque from the employer's nation) and/or standing (minimum standing with the employer's faction; brokers count the Brethren). objective: raid (take or sink `count` ships of the target nation near a port), intercept (a named ship sails the map; take her, or sink her unless capture is true), deliver (carry dispatches or contraband to `dest`). target: enemy (a nation at war with the employer), nation (any nation but the employer's), own (the employer's own nation), pirates. group: the interest group whose influence the job raises. reward_secret: a secret about one of the employer's colleagues. Tiers unlock with the employer's trust in you. success: standing with the employer's faction, trust, and other relations ('target' means the target's faction). Placeholders: {target} {ship} {port} {dest} {good} {qty} {count} {captain}.

dirt_on_the_governor.name: Steal the governor's letters
dirt_on_the_governor.description: The governor's private packet sails aboard the {target} {ship} for {dest}. Take her quietly and bring the letters to {port}'s merchants, who would very much like a governor they can lean on. Attacking a {target} ship is piracy, of course.

ruin_a_rival_house.name: Ruin a rival house: the {ship}
ruin_a_rival_house.description: A rival trading house is undercutting the merchants of {port}. Their {ship} sails for {dest} with {good}. Take her, and the market is ours. She flies the same flag we do, so mind who sees you.

garrison_patrol.name: Clear the coast of the {ship}
garrison_patrol.description: The garrison commander wants the pirate {captain} and the {ship} gone from the waters near {port}, and the governor to know who did it. The military's word will carry more weight after.

alms_voyage.name: Carry alms and medicine to {dest}
alms_voyage.description: The church of {port} is sending alms, medicine and letters to the poor of {dest}. A safe passage will be remembered in the pulpit, and in the governor's council.

planters_goods.name: Cheap {good} for the planters: {qty} to {dest}
planters_goods.description: The planters want {good} without the Crown's duties on it. Run {qty} into {dest} past the customs house; every cargo that gets through makes the planters stronger in council.

raid_shipping.name: Raid {target} shipping off {port}
raid_shipping.description: The Admiralty wants {target} trade strangled. Take or sink {count} {target} ships within a day's sail of {port}.

capture_ship.name: Capture the {ship}
capture_ship.description: The {target} {ship} sails from {port} for {dest} with {good} in her hold. Bring her in as a prize: sunk, she is worth nothing to the Crown.

hunt_pirate.name: Hunt down {captain} of the {ship}
hunt_pirate.description: The pirate {captain} and the {ship} prey on shipping near {port}. Take her or send her to the bottom. The Brethren will not thank you.

dispatches.name: Carry dispatches to {dest}
dispatches.description: Sealed dispatches for the governor at {dest}. Strike your colours and they're lost. Their enemies would pay well to read them.

hijack_cargo.name: Hijack the {ship}'s {good}
hijack_cargo.description: Word is the {target} {ship} loads {good} at {port} for {dest}. Take her and her cargo is yours; the broker wants a finder's fee paid the other way, in favours.

smuggle.name: Run {qty} {good} into {dest}
smuggle.description: {good} is contraband in {dest}, and the planters there will pay for it. The goods are loaded for you. Deliver them to the broker's man on the quay.

revenge.name: Settle a score with {captain}
revenge.description: {captain} of the {ship} cheated the broker of his share. She lurks near {port}. Sink her or take her; either way, see that {captain} learns.

sink_hunter.name: Sink the pirate hunter {ship}
sink_hunter.description: The {target} hunter {ship} has hanged three crews this season and is cruising near {port}. Be rid of her and every captain in the Brethren owes you.
